title: Wipro to Train 10,000 AI Specialists as It Deepens Google Cloud Partnership
excerpt: Indian IT giant launches LIFT framework to help enterprises scale agentic AI, with 1,500 Forward Deployed Engineers leading deployment.
body:
• Wipro will train over 10,000 AI-certified specialists, including 1,500 Forward Deployed Engineers, as part of an expanded partnership with Google Cloud.
  • The company launched its LIFT (Launch-Ignite-Flywheel-Transform) framework to help enterprises move from basic automation to deploying autonomous AI agents in core business workflows.
  • Wipro has already deployed Google's Gemini Enterprise internally for compliance, HR, and sales intelligence workflows.
  • The Everest Group recently named Wipro a Leader in its Google Cloud Services PEAK Matrix Assessment 2026.

Wipro announced on Wednesday an expanded partnership with Google Cloud to accelerate enterprise-wide adoption of Gemini Enterprise and agentic AI, committing to train more than 10,000 AI-certified specialists as India's third-largest IT services firm deepens its bet on artificial intelligence.

The deal, disclosed in an exchange filing, includes building a dedicated team of 1,500 certified Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) who will combine Google Cloud's AI expertise with Wipro's consulting and engineering capabilities to help clients scale AI projects from pilot stages to enterprise-wide deployment.

The LIFT Framework

At the center of the expanded partnership is Wipro's new LIFT (Launch-Ignite-Flywheel-Transform) framework, designed to help enterprises accelerate AI transformation and operationalize agentic AI at scale. Powered by Wipro Intelligence, the company's unified suite of AI platforms and solutions, the framework integrates Gemini Enterprise with Wipro's proprietary delivery platforms WINGS and WEGA.

https://x.com/KommawarSwapnil/status/2092921186267402376

The goal, according to Wipro, is to enable organizations to move beyond basic task automation and embed secure, autonomous AI agents directly into multi-step business workflows — a shift from using AI for isolated tasks to weaving it into core operations like compliance reviews, HR processes, and sales intelligence.

"AI is foundational to how Wipro is shaping its future, driving innovation, transforming operations, and delivering differentiated value for our clients."

— Kanwar Singh, Managing Partner and Global Head of Technology Services, Wipro

Already in Production

Wipro is not just selling the vision to clients — it has already deployed Gemini Enterprise internally as its central agentic orchestration platform. The company is using Gemini's advanced reasoning and long-context capabilities to build autonomous AI agents that streamline workflows across compliance, HR, and sales intelligence functions, according to Outlook Business.

https://youtube.com/watch?v=r_-ybZPOOSI

The IT services firm has also integrated the Antigravity Command Line Interface into its software engineering ecosystem, enabling agentic workflows that assist developers with planning, coding, testing, and application modernization. Wipro said the integration has delivered measurable productivity improvements and reduced post-production defects.

"By embedding Gemini Enterprise into their own operations and their customer-facing platforms, Wipro is demonstrating how AI transformation drives tangible efficiency."

— Kevin Ichhpurani, President, Global Partner Ecosystem, Google Cloud

Indian IT's AI Arms Race

The partnership comes as India's IT services sector races to prove that AI will boost rather than cannibalize demand for outsourcing providers. Wipro's stock has been under pressure — down roughly 30% over the past year — amid investor concerns that AI tools could disrupt the industry's traditional labor-intensive model.

Wipro CEO Srini Pallia pushed back against that narrative during the company's Q1 2026 earnings call. "AI is no longer a niche," he said, according to CIO Dive. "It's becoming essential to how businesses operate at scale." CTO Hari Shetty has called AI "probably the single biggest opportunity" for the industry, telling Reuters it would create more jobs than it displaces, citing World Economic Forum estimates of 170 million new AI-related jobs globally against 92 million displaced.

The expanded Google Cloud partnership adds to a string of AI alliances for Wipro, which joined forces with Nvidia earlier this year to develop an agentic and sovereign enterprise AI portfolio. The Everest Group recently recognized Wipro as a Leader in its Google Cloud Services PEAK Matrix Assessment 2026, citing the company's investments in solutions like WEGA and WINGS alongside its Data for AI framework.

What to Watch

For Indian tech professionals globally, the 10,000-specialist training program signals continued demand for AI-skilled engineers. Wipro's push is part of a broader industry shift where TCS, Infosys, and other Indian IT majors are investing heavily in AI capabilities to position themselves as transformation partners rather than cost-arbitrage providers.

The key question is execution. Moving 10,000 professionals from traditional IT services into certified AI roles is a significant undertaking, and the real test will be whether the LIFT framework can deliver measurable outcomes for enterprise clients navigating their own AI transitions.
nri_angle: Wipro's push to train 10,000 AI specialists signals continued demand for AI-skilled Indian engineers globally, reinforcing the Indian IT sector's role as a major employer of diaspora talent.
